title: [NSW, QLD, SA, VIC] SolarMax: $0/kWh 11am-2pm, $0.165/kWh 12am-6am, $0.15/kWh FiT 6-9pm for First 30kWh @ CovaU

[riantmote] I’ve been comparing CovaU SolarMAX with Flipped Freedom Switched On 2.2 / Solar Sharer, and thought I’d share my calculations for anyone using Solar + Battery + TOU.
🔹 Daily Supply Charges
CovaU: $1.52/day ($554.80/year)
Flipped: $1.05/day ($384.78/year)
➡️ CovaU costs $170.02 more per year.
🔹 FiT Comparison
I never export at night, so I ignore CovaU’s 15c FiT (18:00–21:00).
CovaU FiT: 5c/kWh
Flipped FiT: 2c/kWh
➡️ Difference: 3c/kWh
To make up the extra $170.02 in supply charges, you’d need:
5667kWh/year=170.02÷0.03
Which is: 5667÷365≈15.5kWh/day
👉 So CovaU only becomes cheaper if you export more than ~15.5 kWh/day, every day of the year.
🔹 Free Usage Window (11am–2pm)
CovaU: First 50 kWh free
Flipped: First 24 kWh free
To fully benefit from CovaU’s free 50 kWh, you really need solar + battery, and the ability to fully charge your battery between 11am–2pm.
🔹 My Choice
I ended up choosing Flipped, mainly because I’m not confident I can consistently export 15.5 kWh/day across the whole year.
That said, CovaU’s 50 kWh free window is very tempting, so I’ll keep an eye on things over the next few months—especially in summer.
🔹 Notes
Flipped isn’t available in all states.
For Solar + Battery TOU users, CovaU and Flipped are the two best options I’ve found so far.
If your FiT isn’t high enough(less than 15.5 kWh/day), Flipped is definitely worth considering.
You can also get a $30 credit via the OzBargain community:
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/deals/flipped.energy
